story_type: 76-year-old diver with stroke signs far offshore, basket hoist off a charter dive boat in white water
hook: A 76-year-old diver, 121 miles offshore, showing signs of a stroke.
narration: A seventy-six year old diver, a hundred and twenty-one miles off Texas, showing signs of a stroke.
He had just finished two dives from a charter boat, far out in the Gulf.
A Coast Guard helicopter crew flew out and lowered a rescue swimmer toward the boat.
The basket is the safest way to lift a sick patient. He sits inside, and nothing depends on his grip.
It swung across the white water and down onto the deck.
[short pause] Then it lifted him off the boat, over open water.
outcome: The helicopter crew medevaced the diver off the charter boat, 121 miles from Galveston.
title: Diver, 76, airlifted 121 miles offshore
description:
On Aug. 16, 2014, a Coast Guard rescue helicopter crew medevaced a 76-year-old man from a charter dive vessel 121 miles offshore Galveston, Texas, after he completed two dives and began to show signs of a stroke.
